action: Single short one-handed diagonal cut, facing NORTH throughout, return to starting guard. Back of head and vest back stay visible in every frame; never reveal face or front chest. Sword ALWAYS gripped below guard, fingers closed, pommel past palm, wrist straight; free hand counterbalances. Start soft knees and staggered feet. Slowly shift weight rearward, rotate hips/shoulders only slightly, lift sword beside weapon-side shoulder, bent elbow BELOW fist. Then short forward step, lead foot plants; hips/chest turn slightly and drive the fast diagonal cut through space IN FRONT from high weapon-side shoulder toward opposite hip. Elbow opens naturally, no sideways wrist bend. Knees flex modestly, rear heel pivots; no wide squat. Decelerate after cut, recover to starting north-facing guard. Preparation slow, strike fast, recovery controlled. Fixed camera, same proportions, crisp pixels. No spin, turn-around, lost sword, extra attack, blur, trails, sliding feet, swelling or broken joints.
